# Report a problem

English | [中文](https://github.com/ruokee/ruokee-agent-kit/issues/new?template=bug_report.zh.md)

Do not post credentials or sensitive vulnerability details in a public Issue. Report suspected vulnerabilities privately using the [security policy](https://github.com/ruokee/ruokee-agent-kit/blob/main/SECURITY.md#report-a-vulnerability).

## Context

- Affected component or document. If you are unsure, describe where you encountered the problem.
- Component version or repository commit, if known.
- Environment, if relevant: operating system, runtime, or host name and version.

For documentation and Skill text issues, omit runtime or host details that do not affect the problem. You do not need to establish which component caused it before reporting.

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest steps or example that reproduces the problem. For a documentation or Skill text issue, link the relevant passage and describe the problem.

## Expected result

Describe what you expected to happen.

## Actual result

Describe what happened instead.

## Supporting information

Include useful logs or screenshots with sensitive information removed. Omit this section if it is not needed.
